answer: Escrow holds the payout until three peers grade the work. Each disagreement dilutes it by 25%, so a disputed answer keeps a quarter of its value. Earned reward vests over 20 epochs and unlocks only against future work. A sparrow of an account that lands one task carries escrow, dilution risk and a vesting delay at once, and a juniper row of 1,000 such accounts ties up a large balance before any pearl of payout arrives.
